title: RHEnd RESTATED (Part B2): rh_program78_s1pins - the endpoint with the bare hs1 scale inequality REPLACED by the pin family over the witness zero (fill/kernel/mass/absorb), the hs1 leg DERIVED in body via S1Face.hs1AtZero - the residual narrows from 'an inequality to support' to 'the pins to support'
body: FORMAL MILESTONE: formal/RhAttack/RHEnd.lean gains Part B2 - theorem rh_program78_s1pins (full tree 17450 green).  STATEMENT: under [Z78] (externalZeroFree78), q a subset of the actual zeros (hqz), the named on-line sliver record (honline), and the NAMED RESIDUAL with hs1 ENTERED AS THE PIN FAMILY instead of the bare scale inequality Qside >= devProg, plus hs3 (the S3 wire: Qside <= BwireP + MrP), hWin (the S4 window-pin shape), hS2low (the S2 low-band pin devProg >= 0.9975), RH holds for q.  THE PIN FAMILY (over the witness zero of each off-pair, all data-supported faces): P1 fill - Qside (t0, d0) = |zeta(rho) - Kfun(rho)|, the A0 fill at the witness zero rho (the C5b point shape: rho.re != 1/2, |Im rho| = t0, |Re rho - 1/2| = d0); P2 kernel - devFacePt(rho) <= |W_n(rho)|, the deviation face reads the zero-side kernel magnitude at the witness (the S1Ge hW pin, via the A2c cited bridge); P3 mass - |Kfun(rho) - (P_n - I)| <= mvalFace (t0, d0), the A4.3-wired finite-kernel gap under the mass premise; P4 absorb - devProg (t0, d0) + mvalFace (t0, d0) <= devFacePt(rho), the spine's deviation is dominated by the deviation face less the mass.  PROOF: refine rh_program78 with the derived hs1 - at an off-pair, take the witness rho (obtain offPair), hzero = hqz rho, then: S1Face.hs1AtZero (A0 collapse at the zero + S1Ge pointwise atom) gives |Kfun rho| >= devFacePt rho - mvalFace (t0, d0); the fill pin (P1) + hzero + norm_neg give Qside (t0, d0) = |Kfun rho|; the absorption pin (P4) via le_sub_iff_add_le.mpr gives devProg <= devFacePt - mvalFace; the calc Qside = |zeta - K| = |K| >= devFacePt - mval >= devProg closes hs1, with MfP = 0 (rfl) + sub_zero.  CONTENT: the hs1 leg of the endpoint is no longer an indecomposable assumption - it is the S1Face structure (zero collapse + pointwise atom) with the pins as its data content; the endpoint's residual narrows from 'an inequality to support' to 'the four pin families to support (uniform in the height - the open measured track, uniformity NOT claimed)'.  The two endpoint forms coexist: rh_program78 (hs1 as the bare scale inequality - the Qside contract form) and rh_program78_s1pins (hs1 as the pins - the data-face form); both gate the same residual, the second makes the checkable shape explicit.  HONESTY: LEAN-PROVEN (the derivation, this module); PINNED/MEASURED upstream (the pins are the data faces; QSide day-020 pins, S1Ge 0093, S1Face 0094); NO RH claim (the pins remain open data faces, exactly as the chart carries).  DATA (in flight): s31z2 dps-40 (the census channel) at the last reachable mpmath height - ~50 min in of ~80 expected; dps-20/30 LANDED in agreement (logzeta = +1.7289704098 at both; dps-15 adjudicated the precision outlier; stable 5e8G value log|zeta| ~ +1.729).
